name: Prince of grief
source:
You have been assigned to a laboratory for your graduation research in college.

 The members are all handsome, but they all have darkness in their hearts and are trapped in something.

 Please be close to their hearts and help them free themselves from the spell.

[From [url=https://prlilong.itch.io/prince-of-grief]itch.io[/url]]
